nextStoryContext: US-002 needs a real-git integration test for createLocalIssueOnMain. Mirror test/integration/ship-finalize-dirty-prd.test.ts: mkdtempSync in tmpdir, git init, configure user.email+user.name, seed issues.local.json on main, commit it. Then: Case A checkout feature branch, call createLocalIssueOnMain with realSpawnFn over spawnSync, assert git show main shows the new entry and working tree is clean. Case B: stay on main, call it, assert direct commit landed. The realSpawnFn MUST forward options.env (for GIT_INDEX_FILE) and options.input (for hash-object --stdin). Use spawnSync from node:child_process; wrap it to match the SpawnFn signature from issue-file.ts.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Implementation uses node:fs (mkdtempSync, rmSync, writeFileSync), node:os (tmpdir), node:path (join), and git plumbing via injected SpawnFn. No new external JS library. Bun.TOML.parse is used indirectly via parseToml() (already validated in patterns.md).
